column1: # Declared-only: the pack never scores, classifies or owns a script in a Korean
# or English request (it stays out of their traces) except in a kana sentence.
# A sentence with hiragana grammar and no Hangul is Japanese in any request
# (phase 2, project owner 2026-10-08); Korean kana/hanja options keep Korean.
# A Han or kana run has no spaces and holds several words: it counts as three words against
# Latin words, so a number with its counter (1937年4月) keeps the sentence language when names in
# Latin letters surround it (2026-11-09, real-text cycle R4; it was read in English).
# Pack readings over the same extent as a shared one (USB: katakana letter names).
# 136hp ひゃくさんじゅうろくhp (2026-11-09, real-text cycle R4)
# 6m95 ろくメートルきゅうじゅうご (2026-11-10, real-text cycle R10)
